name: Data.hasGap_gridParam
summary: Unfold the gap conditions entrywise and check them by integer arithmetic, with the parity of the size and w_{a+1} ≥ w_a + h.

steps.claim: The two conditions of a gap (distinct entries of the right parity, spaced by h) for each pair of indices, by integer arithmetic (`Data.card_gridIndex_mod_two`, `Data.w_add_gap_le`).
steps.lean:
τ).HasGap D.h := by constructor <;> norm_cast <;> push_cast [typevec,
  le_abs, reindex_equiv D.gridBlockEquiv.symm, Sum.forall,
  Int.even_iff] <;> grind -ring (splits := 60) [D.card_gridIndex_mod_two z i j, D.w_add_gap_le τ 0]
